title: Anna.exe & Emergent Computation
framing: Methodological contribution, not phenomenal. Not 'AI found'; not consciousness. Prior art named.

anna_exe.what: CFB's Aigarth evolution engine (PE32+, KERNEL32-only, ~5.84MB RAM arena)
anna_exe.substrate: 100-cell ternary lookup-table cellular automaton, <=100 timesteps, control-cell halting

pivotal_finding.statement: The substrate is capable but the monolithic search is not.
pivotal_finding.hand_built_adder: 0 wrong bits over all 16384 pairs, under 1/3 of the cells
pivotal_finding.monolithic_search: stays far above 0; CFB screenshot ~41% wrong partway through; floor rises with size
pivotal_finding.composition: evolve a 1-bit full adder (0 error in a few hundred evals), compose 7 ripple-carry copies = 0 / 131072 wrong bits over all 16384 pairs

decomposition_theorem.claim: For a computation that must generalize to unbounded input size, every algorithm component can emerge by mutation and selection on small examples, and exactly one primitive cannot.
decomposition_theorem.irreducible: the bare iterate-and-check primitive (a while-loop) - a finite-description limit

emerges.evidence: Phase 9: 12/12 invent mod-3, exact to length 128
Phase 15: 8/8 self-halt at W+1, to width 32

decisiveness: A rule correct on 99% of random strings would pass 80,000 of them with probability 0.99^80000 ~ 1e-349.
noise_law: Pre-registered; one half falsified on a new task (Phase 8) then refined (over-provisioning must coincide with overfit-ability).

novelty.one_candidate_new: reading an emerged few-shot learner bit-exactly as a known symbolic algorithm (pending citation-graph check before any 'first')

negative_results.hyperidentity: self-improvement converges to a fixed point; self-application depletes to zero (not a singularity)
negative_results.pioneer_1: exact null - volume-sampler and robustness-sampler posteriors concordant (<=0.056 apart, never flip the winner)
